title: Trailer Strap 150 Inches – Durable Nylon Strap
descriptionHtml:
A strap you can trust

A weak or worn strap is a risk when you're securing or towing a heavy load. You want to be sure it holds all the way.

Durable nylon with good load capacity

This strap is 150 inches long and made of durable nylon. It suits both load securing and emergencies and comes with a handy storage bag.

Features

  • 150 inches long
  • Durable nylon with good load capacity
  • Storage bag included
  • Great for load securing and towing
  • Compact to store in the car

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
